caseStudies.title: Real Estate Lead Generation Campaign Performance
caseStudies.subtitle: Meta Ads Manager — Filtered Campaign View Analysis
caseStudies.overview: Review of a filtered Meta Ads Manager campaign view covering 67 real estate lead generation campaigns across multiple regional builders and property projects.
caseStudies.objective: Generate instant form leads for residential projects while monitoring cost-per-lead (CPL) efficiency across cities and property segments.
caseStudies.role: Campaign coordination, Meta Ads setup, creative alignment, and performance monitoring
availableDataNotes: 67 campaigns represented in the filtered campaign view
3,487 total form leads recorded in the view
Average cost per lead across the view: ₹173.01
Note: Filtered view spans multiple projects; figures are presented strictly as shown without assuming total spend, ROI, or single-client ownership.
observations: Lower CPL was observed on tightly targeted regional projects such as Serenity – Indore (₹51.00 CPL) and Asnani Group – Bhopal (₹54.17 CPL, 338 leads).
Higher-ticket or niche segments such as MBK Villas – Jabalpur carried higher CPL (~₹350.77), highlighting the impact of ticket size and local audience pool depth.
Instant Lead Forms reduced friction for mobile users browsing residential offers.
learnings: Creative clarity (location, configuration, and starting context) helps pre-qualify leads before form submission.
Separating high-CPL villa campaigns from volume apartment campaigns prevents blended averages from masking optimization priorities.
improvementOpportunities: Add qualifying questions in Meta Instant Forms where lead volume is high to support sales follow-up quality.
Refresh ad creatives proactively when frequency rises in mid-sized city audiences.

caseStudies.title: Website Traffic & User Engagement Analysis
caseStudies.subtitle: Google Analytics 4 — Reports Snapshot
caseStudies.overview: Evaluation of overall website traffic volume, new visitor acquisition, and on-site engagement behavior using the GA4 Reports Snapshot.
caseStudies.objective: Understand audience reach, first-time visitor share, and interaction depth across website sessions.
caseStudies.role: Analytics monitoring, traffic & engagement observation, and reporting insights
availableDataNotes: Note: Reflects total site traffic across all acquisition sources (not solely paid advertising).
observations: New users (63K) represent the vast majority of the 71K active users, indicating strong top-of-funnel discovery and fresh reach.
445K recorded events show active scrolling, page loads, and interaction triggers despite a concise 20-second average engagement duration.
learnings: High new-user influx combined with a 20-second average engagement time indicates visitors quickly scan landing sections before deciding to stay or exit.
Above-the-fold clarity and fast page loading are critical when most sessions are first-time visits.
improvementOpportunities: Improve above-the-fold value proposition and clearer call-to-action placement to deepen engagement time.
Track key scroll-depth and enquiry-button click events cleanly to separate passive visits from intent.

caseStudies.title: Advertising Channel & Conversion Insights
caseStudies.subtitle: Google Analytics 4 — Advertising Snapshot
caseStudies.overview: Channel-level review of conversion trends and attribution paths inside the GA4 Advertising Snapshot across key traffic channels.
caseStudies.objective: Observe how Direct, Organic Search, Paid Search, and Unassigned channels contribute to conversion trends and identify tracking hygiene gaps.
caseStudies.role: Attribution & channel observation and analytics reporting coordination
availableDataNotes: Observed channels in view: Direct, Organic Search, Unassigned, Paid Search
Includes conversion trend observation and attribution channel distribution
Note: Exact numeric conversion totals are omitted where not explicitly verified in the supplied report view.
observations: Conversions distribute across Direct, Organic Search, Paid Search, and Unassigned buckets, showing multi-channel discovery.
Presence of Unassigned traffic indicates opportunities to tighten UTM tagging conventions across external campaigns.
learnings: Consistent UTM parameters across social and paid links reduce "Unassigned" attribution and give clearer visibility into campaign contribution.
Organic Search and Direct remain important supporting touchpoints alongside paid acquisition.
improvementOpportunities: Standardize UTM naming (source, medium, campaign) across all Meta and Google campaign URLs.
Review key event definitions in GA4 to ensure meaningful conversion actions are prioritized.

caseStudies.title: Connecting Paid Campaigns, Website Analytics & Marketing Insights
caseStudies.subtitle: Integrated Perspective Across Meta Ads & GA4
caseStudies.overview: Bringing together paid lead generation insights from Meta Ads Manager with website traffic and channel observations from Google Analytics 4 into a cohesive reporting perspective.
caseStudies.objective: Bridge the gap between ad-platform lead metrics and on-site user behavior to inform creative, landing page, and budget decisions.
caseStudies.role: Digital Marketing Coordination, Campaign Monitoring & Reporting Synthesis
availableDataNotes: Combines directional insights from Meta Ads Manager (3,487 form leads across 67 campaigns in view) and GA4 (71K active users, multi-channel attribution).
Important: Meta Ads form leads and GA4 website users are NOT matched at an individual-user level.
The funnel diagram below represents a conceptual marketing framework rather than a single-user tracked journey.
observations: Ad platforms optimize for immediate lead form completions, while GA4 reveals what happens when broader audiences land on website pages (engagement time, channel mix).
Reviewing both together prevents over-focusing on CPL alone when landing experience or UTM attribution also need attention.
learnings: Structured reporting pairs platform-level efficiency (CPL, lead volume) with website health (engagement time, clean attribution).
Honest measurement boundaries build stronger trust with stakeholders and clients.
improvementOpportunities: Align campaign landing pages with ad creative promises to lift 20-second average engagement time.
Maintain unified UTM tracking sheets and weekly creative review cadences.
